title: Qcqs full subcategory of the small pro-etale site with finite covers
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Define $X_{qcqs,\mathrm{proet}}$ to be the full subcategory of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ on objects $U\to X$ whose source scheme $U$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $\iota$ be its full inclusion. Its covering precoverage [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] consists of finite families of its arrows whose underlying scheme family is a pro-etale covering [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering].
